scope: Targeted primary-source novelty screen, not an exhaustive literature review or certification of novelty.

sources.title: KIVI
sources.relevance: Asymmetric 2-bit KV quantization and complete serving gains already published; HF HQQ is not this exact algorithm.

sources.title: QServe
sources.relevance: Joint W4A8KV4 algorithm/system design already published; smaller cache alone is not a new full-stack contribution.

sources.title: KVTuner
sources.relevance: Offline sensitivity-aware layer mixed precision and hardware-friendly configurations already covered.

sources.title: TurboQuant
sources.relevance: Random rotations and scalar/codebook quantization are prior art. We have not reproduced its method or performance.

sources.title: MixKVQ
sources.status: Public research paper; author repository labels ACL 2026
sources.relevance: Query-aware mixed precision for difficult key channels already covered.

sources.title: TriAxialKV
sources.relevance: Recency, modality, semantic role precision allocation with a serving implementation and fused Triton kernels already covered.

sources.title: RateQuant
sources.relevance: Quantizer-specific rate-distortion calibration and per-head bit allocation already covered.

sources.title: UltraQuant
sources.status: September 2026 revision; page labels EMNLP 2026 Industry Track
sources.relevance: 4-bit KV for context-heavy multi-round agents with real deployment kernels and serving results already covered.

sources.title: ReadKV / Read What Matters
sources.relevance: Separate retained and fetched bits; progressive codes; query-dependent key and value reads. Reported latency evidence in abstract is a restricted single-layer experiment, not complete-model serving.

sources.title: QuantSpec
sources.relevance: Self-speculation with quantized weights and hierarchical KV caches already covered.

sources.title: SpecKV
sources.relevance: Compression-aware speculative length selection already covered.

sources.title: MorphServe
sources.relevance: Runtime weight precision swapping and elastic KV capacity under load already covered; distinguish from KV precision refinement.

sources.title: TensorRT-LLM KV cache compression
sources.relevance: Compression at iteration and hot/cold storage boundaries is already a supported design direction.

sources.title: HF Transformers v4.57.1 cache documentation
sources.relevance: Baseline implementation and recommended HQQ axes; warns cache quantization may hurt latency.

sources.title: HF Transformers v4.57.1 cache source
sources.relevance: QuantizedLayer dequantizes stored history and concatenates BF16 tensors before ordinary attention.

sources.title: Qwen3-4B checkpoint
sources.status: Official model card; immutable revision in environment.json
sources.relevance: 4B dense model, 36 layers, 8 KV heads, 128 head dimension; native context stated as 32,768 tokens.
